assays.assay_name: von Frey test (formalin-induced secondary mechanical allodynia and hyperalgesia)
assays.assay_description: Rats placed in testing cages with a wire mesh bottom, acclimated 30 min; von Frey filaments (10 mN for allodynia and 250 mN for hyperalgesia) applied 10 times per testing set at the base of the third toe on the plantar surface of both (ipsilateral and contralateral) paws, three trials averaged; number of paw withdrawal responses counted before (Pre) and after (Post) intra-VLO microinjection of DOI (0.1, 1, 10 µg/µl), alone or after pretreatment with ketanserin, kynurenic acid, U73122, chelerythrine (intra-VLO) or GABA (intra-vlPAG). Tested 6 days after hindpaw formalin injection.

application_type.evidence: Intracerebral (intraparenchymal) microinjection: 'a 1.0 µl microsyringe ... was inserted to the VLO through the guide cannula'; GABA was microinjected into bilateral vlPAG. Not intraventricular.

setup_habituation.evidence: Rats were placed in testing cages with a wire mesh bottom and allowed to acclimate for 30 min; 'On the day of testing, the rats were acclimated to the experimental arena for 30 min prior to testing.'

setup_restrain.evidence: Rats were placed in testing cages with a wire mesh bottom and allowed to acclimate for 30 min (no restraint during testing; brief immobilization was only for formalin injection).

food_restriction.evidence: Testing took place in testing cages with a wire mesh bottom; no food is described in the testing apparatus (home cage food/water ad libitum).

water_restriction.evidence: Testing took place in testing cages with a wire mesh bottom; no water is described in the testing apparatus (home cage food/water ad libitum).

time_to_assay.evidence: Paw withdrawal responses were measured 'before (Pre) and after DOI injection (Post)' on the day of testing; the exact Pre-to-Post interval is not stated numerically.

sample_size.evidence: Data are expressed as the mean (n = 6) ± SEM of paw withdrawal ipsilateral (IL) and contralateral (CL) responses (Figs. 2-8).

outcomes.summary: Intra-VLO microinjection of DOI (0.1, 1, 10 µg/µl) reduced formalin-induced secondary mechanical allodynia (10 mN) and hyperalgesia (250 mN) in the ipsilateral paw but not the contralateral paw; the effect was not dose-dependent. The antinociceptive effect was blocked by pretreatment with ketanserin, kynurenic acid, U73122, chelerythrine (intra-VLO) and GABA (intra-vlPAG), each of which alone had no effect.
outcomes.evidence: Post hoc Bonferroni test indicated that microinjection of various doses of DOI (0.1 µg/µl, 1 µg/µl, 10 µg/µl; 0.5 µl), a 5-HT2A receptor agonist, into the VLO reversed the development of secondary mechanical allodynia and hyperalgesia induced by 1% formalin in the ipsilateral paw (P < 0.01; Fig. 3A and B), but there is no dose-dependent.

B1_num_measures.evidence: Number of paw withdrawal responses to the 10 mN filament (allodynia) and to the 250 mN filament (hyperalgesia), reported for ipsilateral and contralateral paws.

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Three trials were completed to get an average of the number of paw withdrawal responses; no within-session time-course analysis.

B3_sequential_structure.evidence: No analysis of behavioural transitions, sequences or bout microstructure is reported.

B4_ethological.evidence: Only reflexive paw withdrawal responses to von Frey filaments were measured; no natural behaviours scored.

B5_social.evidence: Rats were tested individually in testing cages; no social construct is targeted.

B6_cognitive.evidence: Reflexive nociceptive withdrawal threshold testing; no learning or memory component.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: Withdrawal responses were counted by a blinded experimenter ('experimenter was blind to the treatment conditions'); no computational behavioural classifier.

B8_multivariate.evidence: Analyses were two-way/one-way ANOVA with Bonferroni post hoc; no dimensionality reduction or multivariate analysis.

E1_environment_type.evidence: Rats were placed in testing cages with a wire mesh bottom and allowed to acclimate for 30 min.

E7_social_context.evidence: Each rat was tested individually in its testing cage; no conspecific present during recording.

D1_continuity.evidence: Paw withdrawal responses were measured 'before (Pre) and after DOI injection (Post)', i.e. at least two separate recording bouts whose data are reported.

D2_session_duration.evidence: Duration of each von Frey testing session is not stated numerically (only '10 times in each testing set' and 'three trials').

D3_recording_days.evidence: The sixth day was chosen to evaluate nociceptive behaviors; Pre and Post measurements were taken on the same test day.

D4_baseline.evidence: Paw withdrawal responses ... before (Pre) and after DOI injection (Post) — pre-drug baseline recorded and reported.

D5_followup.evidence: No behavioural recording ≥24 h after the DOI microinjection is reported.

judge_notes: Merged all candidates' von Frey / formalin secondary allodynia-hyperalgesia entries into a single assay: all DOI dose arms and all antagonist pretreatments (ketanserin, kynurenic acid, U73122, chelerythrine, intra-vlPAG GABA) are the same paradigm (von Frey paw-withdrawal counts) under different pharmacological manipulations.

Dropped the Open Field Test and Rotarod test entries included by deepseek4 and gemma4: these compared naïve (N) vs catheterization (C) groups only ('Effect of the catheterization on the motor function by open field test and rotarod test'); no psychedelic (DOI) was administered for these tests, so per the rubric they are not scorable assays.

B1 set to '2-3' (score 1) — two distinct filament-force measures (10 mN allodynia, 250 mN hyperalgesia) reported per paw; qwen's '4-6' over-counts by treating ipsi/contra as separate measures, and gemma's score of 2 was inconsistent with its own '2-3' label.

application_type/route set to 'other' (intraparenchymal intracerebral microinjection into the VLO/vlPAG via guide cannula), not 'i.c.v.' as two candidates stated — the drug was not delivered into a ventricle.

D1 scored 1 (multiple discrete sessions) following the majority, based on the repeatedly reported 'before (Pre) and after (Post)' recordings; D2 scored 0 with low confidence because session duration is never stated numerically.
day_night_flipped scored 'no' (majority) based on explicit 'normal light-dark cycle'; direction/times not given, hence medium confidence.
